title: AI accelerator supply constraints beyond CoWoS: IC substrates (ABF/BT, T-glass), rack-scale integration, optics and power equipment (2023-2027)
why_it_matters: As CoWoS and HBM capacity expand, the binding constraint on AI hardware appears to move to substrate materials (T-glass), rack assembly, optics and grid power; evidence found in RU-0016 is thin and mostly press-based.
questions: What are the quantified shortages and lead times for T-glass, ABF substrates, and high-layer PCBs for AI systems 2024-2027?
When do Nittobo and alternative glass-cloth suppliers add capacity, and who is qualifying?
How much AI capacity is delayed by power/grid availability versus chip supply?
subquestions: Do Ibiden, Unimicron, AT&S or Nittobo filings quantify AI-driven demand?
primary_sources: Nitto Boseki, Ibiden, Unimicron annual reports
